# TV Guide

> > Comprehensive television and streaming entertainment guide featuring TV listings, streaming recommendations for Netflix, Hulu, HBO, Peacock, and Prime Video, plus entertainment news and celebrity coverage.

TV Guide provides daily TV schedules, local listings, live sports programming, and curated recommendations for streaming services. The site covers major entertainment franchises including Game of Thrones, Star Trek, and Bridgerton, with seasonal previews and reviews from entertainment journalists like Tim Surette.

## Key Topics

- TV listings and schedules
- Netflix, Hulu, HBO, Peacock, Prime Video streaming
- Entertainment news and reviews
- Live sports programming (MLB, NBA, NHL, soccer)
- Streaming recommendations
- New TV series and premieres
- Movie recommendations
- Cable and antenna TV guides
- Celebrity news
- Seasonal TV previews
- Oscar nominees and awards coverage
- Game of Thrones, Star Trek, Bridgerton franchises

## TV Listings & Schedules

- [TV Guide Homepage](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Listings](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide listings and channel information for today's programming
- [Live Sports On TV Today](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule: MLB, NBA, NHL, soccer broadcasts
- [Cary, NC TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/27518-cary-nc): Local TV listings for Cary, NC antenna and cable providers

## Streaming Guides & Recommendations

- [Best Shows on Netflix](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of top 55 Netflix shows including Vladimir and Bridgerton
- [Best Movies on Netflix](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Netflix movie recommendations featuring Jurassic World Rebirth
- [Best Movies on Peacock](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-peacock): Peacock movie recommendations including Oscar nominees Hamnet and Bugonia

## TV Previews & Entertainment News

- [Complete Guide to Winter TV 2025-2026](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter TV preview with Stranger Things and new premieres
- [New Shows of Winter 2026](https://tvguide.com/galleries/the-new-shows-of-the-2025-2026-winter-tv-season): Gallery of winter 2026 premieres from Game of Thrones and Star Trek
- [Love Story Review (FX)](https://tvguide.com/news/love-story-review-fx-carolyn-bessette-jfk-jr): Review of FX limited series about JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette
